question: Which experiment is Ernest Rutherford well known for performing in 1911?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Gold foil experiment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Gold foil experiment**, also known as the **Rutherford scattering experiment**, was conducted by **Ernest Rutherford** in **1911**.
 
• In this experiment, Rutherford and his team bombarded a thin sheet of **gold foil** with **alpha particles** (helium nuclei).
